step.label: Receive and validate inbound materials
step.description: Verify that raw materials and components from suppliers meet quality standards and inventory requirements before production.
step.useCase: Procurement team confirms material receipts match purchase orders and specifications.

step.label: Assess product engineering changes
step.description: Evaluate engineering change requests and their impact on material specifications and product item configurations for the new product line.
step.useCase: Engineering team determines if material updates or product redesigns are needed before launch.

step.label: Manage engineering change documentation
step.description: Create and maintain engineering change records and updated product item master data to reflect approved modifications.
step.useCase: Technical documentation team updates product specifications and change logs for compliance tracking.

step.label: Monitor service delivery operational readiness
step.description: Track change requests and IT equipment readiness to ensure infrastructure and support systems are prepared for product launch.
step.useCase: Operations team verifies that service ticket infrastructure and change management processes are operational.

step.label: Assess workplace safety for production
step.description: Evaluate hazardous substance handling and potential safety incidents in the manufacturing environment before full production begins.
step.useCase: Safety manager ensures all hazardous materials are properly documented and incident protocols are in place.

step.label: Align sales team capabilities
step.description: Identify and assign sales employees with appropriate skills and hierarchy positioning to support the product launch strategy.
step.useCase: Sales leadership identifies top performers and their direct reports for customer engagement and territorial assignments.

step.label: Analyze sales compensation impact
step.description: Review compensation structures and performance metrics for sales team to ensure incentive alignment with new product launch targets.
step.useCase: HR and sales finance teams model commission structures and forecast revenue impact on employee bonuses.

step.label: Enrich customer orders with launch details
step.description: Populate customer accounts and orders with product launch information, pricing, and availability to enable seamless order processing.
step.useCase: Sales operations team ensures all customer systems reflect new product SKUs, pricing tiers, and promotional bundles.
